title: Digestible Energy Measurement by Bomb Calorimetry
author: Trina Knotts
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ygkftuw

steps.title: Prepare Mice and Initial Weights
steps.instruction: House mice singly in clean cages with fresh food, water, and low bedding. Record the initial weight of the mouse and the 'food-in' (grams of rodent diet provided at the start).

steps.title: Save Diet Samples
steps.instruction: Save several pellets of rodent diet for energy or macronutrient content analysis.

substeps.instruction: Store pellets at 4°C in an airtight container.

steps.title: Perform Intermediate and Final Weighing
steps.instruction: Monitor and record weights of the mouse and remaining food ('food-out') at specific intervals.

substeps.instruction: Weigh mouse and 'food-out' at the end of the 48h collection period.

steps.title: Reset Housing and Collect Feces
steps.instruction: Replace cage components and collect all fecal matter from the cage bottoms.

substeps.instruction: Swap cage bottoms with new clean bottoms, replace feeder insert/water bottle, and return animals to the housing system.
Carefully inspect and remove each piece of bedding using tweezers to collect all feces.
Inspect each fecal pellet to ensure no spilled food, hair fibers, or bedding are attached.
If significant food spillage is found in the cage bottom, weigh it in a pre-tared weigh boat to add back to food measurement.

steps.title: Process and Store Fecal Samples
steps.instruction: Quantify the wet weight of the feces and store for analysis.

substeps.instruction: Place feces in a labeled pre-weighed 1.5 ml tube.
Subtract the tube weight from the total weight to determine fecal 'wet' weight.
Store fecal samples at -80°C until bomb calorimetry analysis.

steps.title: Submit Samples for Analysis
steps.instruction: Prepare and ship samples to the Mouse Biology Program at UC Davis.

substeps.instruction: Enclose the fecal/diet sample log with samples.
Ship samples on dry ice to: Mouse Biology Program C/O UC Davis MMPC, University of California, 2795 Second Street, Suite 400, Davis, CA 95618.
Include the MBP/MMPC project # in the reference section of the package documentation.
Send the FedEx/UPS tracking number to mmpc-bodyc@ucdavis.edu.
